reviews.text: Anthony & Larry did an awesome job installing my new shower door. They were professional & left the area spotless after they were done installing it. Highly recommend going to Ameristar for glass installments.
reviews.author: Hannah Smith

reviews.text: Today Juan and Dylan came for fixing our glasses. They did the best. Both of them were very professional and experts on their skills. I would strongly recommend them. Work done was so neat and perfect. Thank you, Ameristar team!
reviews.author: Rama Chandran

reviews.text: This Five Star review is for Hero who came to my apartment to put in new. balancers for two windows. There are 16 windows in my apartment and I was having trouble with a lot of them. Two other men had been sent out before him: First One was supposed to check all windows to see which needed repairing. Second One came to put a balancer in one window.  Third one was Hero who came to fix two windows. When I told him that I had other windows I couldn't even open, he checked the windows. He went through room by room, made notes, tagged 3 windows that needed replacement,  fixed two windows and explained to the Front Desk what the problems were. He took the time to do the job right. He was also very respectful and polite; I really appreciated his help and hope he is the one who comes back if Management puts in the order. Thank you,  Hero!
reviews.author: Tia Gibson

reviews.text: Juan A & Dylan R did a great job repairing my balcony window. Extremely fast and efficient. Would definitely recommend!
reviews.author: Calvin Mooney

reviews.text: Always a great experience with Ameristar, shoutout to John for great customer service, I called 10 minutes before closing and he took my call respectfully and booked us a window repair promptly!
reviews.author: Spring Lake Village Leasing

reviews.text: I'm a maintenance supervisor for an apartment complex and have used Ameristar for years. Steven up there has always been our rep, and has been ridiculous fast on his response time to any requests i have had. He has always accommodated our properties needs with great care and consideration.
reviews.author: Matt Pace

reviews.text:
Great customer service !
Steven is a knowledgeable,  respectful, and hard working sales rep.
The installers are always professional and courteous.
I have never had a negative experience with this company. I have used them for years and will continue to do so!
reviews.author: Robert Lariviere

reviews.text:
Had our apartment window replaced. Saw the guy break the window. Once the window was replaced, asked the guy if he cleaned up ALL the glass. He said "yes, everything is clean".  This was NOT the case!  There was glass on window sill, floor, couch and pillows!!
Extremely unprofessional!
reviews.author: A B

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. The low volume (28) is a minor concern but the content is credible, detailed, and spans years. The single negative review is specific and plausible. Glassdoor's lower rating pertains to employee experience, not customer service.
fake_signals: Low review volume (28) could be manipulated, but no clear fake patterns detected in content
authentic_signals: Specific employee names and project details mentioned
Varied writing styles and perspectives (apartment resident, leasing office, maintenance supervisor)
Mix of praise and specific negative feedback
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google and Glassdoor provide ratings. Google's 4.1 is positive, while Glassdoor's 3.2 (24% below industry average) reflects internal employee sentiment, not customer service quality. This is not a discrepancy in customer review authenticity.
